summary: A 38-year-old woman from Denver sustained a non-life-threatening leg injury while hiking the Royal Arch Trail; reported about 2:30 p.m. Saturday. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group performed a litter evacuation to the trailhead (about two hours); she declined ambulance transport. City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks assisted.
notes: Date from Boulder County government press release ('Saturday, May 1, 2021'; 2021-05-01 was Saturday). BCSO case #21-2095.
